g.text: The four first-letter sets are disjoint
and partition F₂ except {e}, of mass 0

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 19px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #994b20

g.text: Their total mass would be both 1 and 2.

text.style: font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #994b20

g.text: Therefore this F₂ regular product is not AFD.
